rules.source: BAMIS Boro Crop Calendar, Faridpur District (Department of Agricultural Extension, Bangladesh)
rules.source_quote: Blast Night temperature 16-20oC, for 7.30 hours day temperature 25-30oC, for 7.30 hours day night temperature >10oC Relative Humidity >90%, cloudy weather

assumptions.why: BAMIS says 'cloudy weather'; the app treats ≥50% cloud cover as cloudy
BAMIS specifies 7.30 hours; discrete 1-hour forecast checks count ≥7 hours within 16-20°C during night hours (19:00-06:00)
BAMIS specifies 7.30 hours; discrete 1-hour forecast checks count ≥7 hours within 25-30°C during day hours (07:00-18:00)
BAMIS specifies 'day night temperature >10oC'; evaluated as (day max temp - night min temp) > 10°C

rules.source: BAMIS Boro Crop Calendar, Sylhet District (Department of Agricultural Extension, Bangladesh)
rules.source_quote: Sheath Blight Temperature 28-32o C, high Relative Humidity, Cloudy weather

assumptions.why: BAMIS says 'high Relative Humidity'; the app treats ≥80% RH as high
BAMIS says 'Cloudy weather'; the app treats ≥50% cloud cover as cloudy
BAMIS specifies 'Temperature 28-32o C'; to prevent false triggers during cool nights, the app assumes night minimum ≥22°C

rules.source: BAMIS Boro Crop Calendar, Sylhet District (Department of Agricultural Extension, Bangladesh)
rules.source_quote: Blight Temperature 28-30o C, Relative Humidity 80-90%, Cloudiness, Rainfall >30mm

assumptions.why: BAMIS says 'Cloudiness'; the app treats ≥50% cloud cover as cloudy
BAMIS says 'Rainfall >30mm'; the app sums precipitation over a 24-hour day
BAMIS specifies 'Temperature 28-30o C'; to prevent false triggers during cool nights, the app assumes night minimum ≥22°C

unsupported_diseases.reason: Not supported by BAMIS crop calendar sources: insect vector (green leafhopper) dynamic rather than microclimate trigger
Not supported by BAMIS crop calendar sources: physiological soil/nutrient stress and secondary fungal pathogen
Not supported by BAMIS crop calendar sources: minor disease without documented microclimate early warning rule
